**Claim C-1088: report for investigator**

The score is 22.2. The band is High. The action is: assign an investigator. Coverage is 90.1%. Rules AS-6, CT-7 and NL-5 were not evaluated. A rule that could not run counts as not fired, so the score may be too low.

**Fired rules**

- **BI-2, Medical build-up:** The adjuster file (C-1088-adjuster_file, page 1) says visits "increased to nearly daily" and care is "well beyond what is usual for a strain of this kind."
- **BI-3, Mostly subjective findings:** The medical records (C-1088-medical_records, page 2) say imaging was unremarkable and exams were normal. They say "Nearly all of the reported findings rest on the patient's own description of pain and function."
- **BI-5, Attorney before first treatment:** The attorney was retained on 2024-12-16. The first visit was on 2024-12-23.
- **BI-6, Heavy early treatment:** There were 15 visits in the first 30 days after the 2024-12-15 loss.
- **NL-3, Same clinic and same attorney:** There are 10 possible links to other claims. All share Harrington Physical Therapy and David Richardson. The claims are C-1085, C-1123, C-1297, C-1313, C-1318, C-1351, C-1355, C-1385, C-1463 and C-1496.
- **NL-6, Large linked cluster:** The group has 12 claims.

**Other facts**

The claim was reported on 2024-12-23. There are 33 visits through 2025-05-08. Three payments total 17,652.74. The repair estimate is 5,356.58.

**Limits**

The links were not checked against other claims of the same claimant. Copied text was also not checked.

This is an unusual pattern. It shows possible links. It needs human review. It is not a finding of fraud.
